text:
emma: Heads-up — docs CI linkcheck is failing after the migration. Docusaurus build error: Link checker reports broken fragments for headings with smart punctuation and soft hyphens (e.g. `#user‑journey—overview` and `#setup…examples`).
chris: Yup, seen that. mkdocs slugify vs docusaurus slugify are normalizing differently. Some headings still contain ZWJ/soft-hyphen chars. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
jordan: can you paste the exact failing lines from the CI log?
emma: sure, from the linkcheck job:
```
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./getting-started/overview.mdx: anchor not found: user-journey--overview
[linkcheck] WARNING: ./guides/setup.mdx: anchor not found: setup-examples
```
chris: quick repro: headings with U+00AD (soft hyphen) or U+2026 (ellipsis) become different slugs in docusaurus. We should strip ZW-space/soft-hyphen before slug generation.
sara: I can open a tiny PR that normalizes headings in the docs preprocessor. Proposed change: run a sanitizer step that strips `​-‍`, `﻿`, `­` and replaces fancy ellipsis with `...`. Example sed snippet to include in the pipeline: 
```bash
sed -E 's/[​-‍﻿­]//g; s/…/.../g' -i "$file"
```
(chris: that looks good — maybe also collapse multiple spaces after removals)
chris: also add a unit test to the docs linter that ensures a set of sample headings slugify identically under both toolchains.
sara: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 — adds sanitizer + test + brief note in the migration guide. pinged @chris @emma for review. :eyes:
emma: thanks! assign to docs owners and mark for quick review. once CI passes we should run a one-off job to backfill `main` (apply sanitizer to all MDX files).
jordan: I can run the backfill after merge — will coordinate with eng-infra to run as a repo maintenance job (non-destructive, commits only when diff).
deploy-bot: CI started for PR #1427 — linkcheck and docs-lint jobs queued.
sara: updated PR based on chris comments (collapse spaces, added test cases for `…` and Windows CRLF samples).
emma: lgtm from me. please merge when green. :thumbsup:
jordan: once merged I'll kick off the backfill job and post status here.
emma: perfect — thanks everyone. closing thread after backfill completes. :white_check_mark:
